name: new_bank_v2_grabmyo_score_space_personal_anchor
calibration_repetitions: for budget N use native repetitions 1..N of every class, same subject and phase
calibration: For each gesture h, mean its source-trained class-probability vectors from labelled target calibration repetitions; q(h|x)=softmax(-squared Euclidean distance(query probability, prototype_h)/0.1). For N>0, final probability=0.5*source_probability+0.5*q; N=0 exactly replays source probability.
selection: fixed rule for all arms, phases and budgets; no hyperparameter or model selection from validation/final scores
scope: same-user score-space prototype follow-up on public 2048 Hz recordings; not raw-EMG F7 feature anchors, not own 250 Hz device, not live recognition
boundary: Day2 and Day3 target calibration labels are allowed only for repetitions 1..N; trials 6 and 7 never fit anchors; final Day3 cohort previously inspected
